findings.description: The dedicated shorten/omit fallback assertion does not cover Extra Large. `LargeSizeOmitsRatherThanOverflowsOnAShortPoster` still exercises only `BadgeSize.Large`; Extra Large is covered across the safe-area sweep `NoPillPaintsOutsideTheSafeAreaOnNarrowAndShortPosters` (which tolerates a fully-empty layout) and the clamp theory `SafeAreaClampReducesTheEffectiveScaleOnAShortPoster`. The phase acceptance criterion ('never paints outside the safe area') is satisfied, so this is coverage depth, not a defect: there is no explicit assertion that an Extra Large layout on a short poster actually omits/shortens while the clamp binds rather than producing an empty or out-of-bounds layout.
findings.recommended_action: Optional: add an Extra Large case to the omit/shorten fallback test (or assert a non-empty in-bounds rail at the clamped scale) in a later task; not required for Gate 18.

findings.description: The `rendererSize` dropdown order, option value and label are verified structurally against the embedded page resource; the page's inline JavaScript (which populates the select from `config.Renderer.Size`) is not executed because the repository has no JavaScript runtime and the pinned host runs without a web client. The round-trip wiring is otherwise unchanged (`config.html:692` populate, `:799` submit). The reordering means a browser that never runs the populate script would show `Small` before configuration data loads; ADR-027 clause 3 mandates this exact order and the saved value is read from the select, so there is no persisted behavior change. This was already noted by the task reviewers.
findings.recommended_action: None for Gate 18; a live-host settings-page check is part of Phase 21 verification.
